jobs.title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Drives product strategy and roadmap for solutions within the Primavera CoE portfolio, partnering with business stakeholders to maximize business value and reuse across GE Vernova. Leads globally distributed technical teams to execute multiple interdependent projects and meet On Time Delivery (OTD) targets. Partners with development leadership and cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business needs into actionable work and resolve execution roadblocks. Influences program direction and investment priorities, providing technical leadership and mentorship to Technical Product Managers across the organization

Job Description
The Sr Staff Technical Product Manager - DT (Digital Technology) fosters a strong and effective partnership with various functions, including project management, contract management, logistics, finance, sourcing, and more, focusing on Project Execution within Gas Power HDGT and across GE Vernova. This role involves providing the necessary processes, tools, and applications to execute projects and achieve business goals. The role includes driving and implementing business specific or global solutions that utilize other Primavera CoE solutions.

As a member of the Primavera CoE, you will be tasked with defining and executing strategic roadmaps, focusing on initiatives that support business objectives and meet On Time Delivery (OTD) targets. By leveraging key technologies, processes, and domain expertise, you will drive execution across multiple interdependent projects within a program. You will manage interfaces across applications that support and drive cross-functional and cross-system initiatives around Oracle Primavera P6, Pulse (homegrown platform), UDC (Unified Data Center – homegrown platform), Time Control, Safran and Oracle Primavera Unifier.
You will lead globally distributed vendor teams, ensuring they meet Safety Quality Delivery Cost (SQDC) targets and requirements. You will provide tactical direction, balancing the development of new capabilities, driving reuse, maintenance activities, issue resolution, technical debt, vulnerability management, and addressing the latest business priorities to enhance the team's quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
This role is crucial in ensuring consistency in platforms, tools, software architecture, and data integration strategy within your domains and across the GE Vernova application landscape. Additionally, you will define standard work within your domain of responsibility and establish lean execution standards and processes for project teams. You will also drive utilization of AI tools such as Claude Code across the team as part of these activities.

In this role, you will:

Product Ownership and Roadmap
- Act as the owner of platforms (multiple instances), applications and the satellite tools, within the CoE portfolio
- Drive the program in accordance with Application Ownership standard work processes.
- Partner with business stakeholders to define platform strategy, drive adoption, and maintain a product roadmap aligned with business value.
- Identify and drive implementation of cross-business solutions that deliver greater business value and increase reuse opportunities.
- Own and manage the backlog, continuously prioritizing based on validated customer problems, business needs, and strategic objectives to ensure PI and sprint readiness.
- Own the short-term roadmap for MVPs and quarterly releases.
- Translate unstructured or ambiguous work requests into actionable user stories and work units.

Cross-Functional Delivery and Execution
- Work with cross-functional teams to deliver features and major, complex products across GE Vernova by leveraging Primavera CoE solutions and pillar applications.
- Manage day-to-day execution of multiple interdependent projects by working directly with global technical teams across Vernova and resolving roadblocks and dependencies.
- Partner with Development Leadership to ensure a healthy and effective development process.
- Engage closely with the development team to facilitate discussions, provide clarification, support story refinement and acceptance, and contribute to testing, validation, and design decisions.

Stakeholder Partnership and Business Alignment
- Engage customers and stakeholders to gather VOC, refine requirements, and obtain product feedback.
- Partner with business stakeholders to define appropriate scheduling and planning structures that support system integrations and leverage industry best practices through strong functional expertise
- Routinely collaborate with UX, Architecture, and Engineering teams on issues, governance, and strategic decisions.
- Use strong persuasion and influencing skills to align customers, product management, and software engineering teams.

Technical and Strategic Leadership
- Influence program direction and priorities by identifying opportunities that maximize business value, reuse, and long-term platform sustainability.
- Demonstrate a strong understanding of the technology stack and its impact on the final product.
- Apply strong problem decomposition skills and navigate ambiguity to drive effective solutions.
- Mentor and develop other Technical Product Managers.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related technical discipline, or equivalent knowledge/experience.
- 11+ years of experience in IT.
- Strong experience implementing system integrations
- Demonstrable history of delivering quality IT projects on schedule.
- Significant IT experience with business systems and their influence on business functions.
- Strong leadership experience in a complex and fast-paced environment.
- Strong experience practicing Agile project management.
- Ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple interdependent initiatives.
- Ability to quickly learn complex systems and business processes and apply that knowledge to solution identification and delivery.
- Skilled in stakeholder negotiation and in communicating a synthesized perspective to the scrum team.

Preferred Qualifications

The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.

The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.

Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).

As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – GridBeats™ Device Management
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
About GE Vernova

At GE Vernova, we are leading the electrification of the world, helping to ensure a reliable and sustainable energy future. Our Grid Automation & Software business is at the forefront of this mission, providing critical solutions for monitoring, controlling, protecting and optimizing electrical grids.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to lead GridBeats™ Device Management (DvM) — a core component of GridBeats™, our portfolio of software-defined automation solutions for grid digitalization.
GridBeats™ DvM is a powerful software suite enabling remote monitoring, control, and lifecycle management of grid intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) — including protection relays, fault recorders, power quality meters, and sensing equipment. Designed for distribution and transmission utilities, renewable operators, and industrial customers, DvM enhances operational efficiency, cybersecurity, and system resilience.
As Senior Product Manager, you will own product strategy, discovery, and delivery — working directly with customers and cross-functional teams to build solutions that solve real problems, deliver measurable outcomes, and shape the future of grid automation.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Strategy
- Define and own a compelling, outcome-driven product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap aligned with GridBeats™ business goals.
- Translate market insights and customer problems into prioritized opportunities with measurable business outcomes — not just a list of features.
- Make crisp, well-reasoned prioritization decisions and align senior stakeholders across product, engineering, sales, and executive leadership.

Customer & Market Discovery
- Conduct continuous customer discovery — engaging operators, protection engineers, and utility leaders to uncover deep pain points and unmet needs.
- Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory trends (NERC CIP, IEC 61850, IEC 62351), and technology shifts to inform strategy.
- Represent GE Vernova at industry events and conferences (DistribuTECH, CIGRE, etc.).

Business Strategy & Commercial Ownership
- Own and maintain the multi-year business case including revenue forecasts, cost-to-build, margin targets, and investment prioritization.
- Define and own the software licensing model and policy — including license types (subscription, perpetual, term-based), optional module packaging, asset-count or capacity-based tiers, and yearly extension terms.
- Establish and govern the software lifecycle policy for DvM releases — including version support windows, end-of-life timelines, upgrade path commitments, and security patch obligations — balancing customer operational risk with engineering sustainability.
- Lead strategic decisions on deployment and go-to-market models — evaluating and recommending the appropriate mix of on-premises, cloud-hosted, hybrid, and SaaS delivery options per customer segment — and ensure these choices are reflected in pricing, contracts, and partner channel strategy.

Product Definition & Delivery
- Lead the full product lifecycle — from concept and business case through requirements, development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
- Lead all release front-end activities — defining and owning business and product requirements across each release cycle, whether operating within a structured gate process or an Agile sprint/PI Planning cadence.
- Write crisp, outcome-focused product artifacts — opportunity canvases, PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that communicate intent without over-specifying solutions. Ensure requirements are baselined, traceable, and accepted by key stakeholders before development commitment.
- Work in close collaboration with commercial, engineering, design & delivery teams.

Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement
- Partner with Marketing to develop impactful messaging, collateral, and campaigns across all channels.
- Work with global sales teams to build key customer relationships, execute go-to-market strategies, and deliver product training and awareness programs.

Performance & Metrics
- Define and track product KPIs — including adoption, retention, time-to-value, financial results, and market share.
- Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to drive decisions and implement continuous improvement or course corrections.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
- 5+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading industrial or enterprise B2B software products.
- Experience building modern software products using containers and microservices architectures, supporting multiple deployment models (on-premise, cloud, SaaS).
- Proficiency in data-driven decision-making — defining metrics, running analyses, and navigating ambiguity to develop and communicate product strategy.
- Hands-on experience with modern product innovation methodologies — Product Discovery, Lean Startup, Design Thinking, or similar.
- Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate core PM workflows (e.g. customer discovery synthesis, PRD drafting, competitive analysis, opportunity sizing, etc.).
- Familiarity with Agile and other NPI methodologies.
- Ability to work effectively with globally distributed, cross-functional teams; willingness to travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications
- Direct experience with electrical utilities, smart grid, device management, protection relays, SCADA, fault recorders, IoT, or industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850).
- Experience applying AI/ML capabilities in product strategy and roadmap decisions and AI-based prototyping to accelerate product discovery and validation cycles.

Desired Characteristics

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.

The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.

Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).

As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.

Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
- Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
- Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
- Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
- User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.

- Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.

- Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
- Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.

- 3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

Position Requirements:
- Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
- Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.
- Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
- Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.
- Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and occasionally C-Suite executives.
- Experience building and deploying AI applications.
- Problem-Solving Skills: Analytical skills to identify and solve risks and challenges.
- Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset

jobs.title: Ingénieur d'application principal (Lead Application Engineer) – Solutions de gestion de la performance des actifs (APM) H/F/Lead Application Engineer – Asset Performance Management Solutions H/F
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary
Rejoignez l'équipe R&D de GE Vernova en tant que pont technique entre la gestion de produit et le développement de produits. En tant qu'ingénieur d'application principal pour les solutions de performance des actifs, vous traduirez les besoins des clients et les exigences produits définis par la gestion de produit en algorithmes innovants, conceptions de solutions et prototypes fonctionnels destinés aux équipes de développement. Il s'agit d'un rôle de contributeur individuel opérationnel au sein de la R&D, sans responsabilité de gestion d'équipe. Ce poste exige une expertise approfondie dans la maintenance centrée sur la fiabilité (RCM), la gestion de la performance des actifs (APM) et la gestion des actifs, combinée à de solides bases en mathématiques, statistiques et optimisation.
L'ingénieur d'application principal sera responsable de l'ensemble du processus de conception de la solution, de la réception des exigences priorisées et des points de douleur des clients jusqu'à la livraison des spécifications algorithmiques et des prototypes prêts pour le développement. Le candidat retenu devra posséder d'excellentes capacités de communication, une approche méthodique et structurée de la résolution de problèmes, ainsi qu'une compréhension globale de la fiabilité des actifs, de l'optimisation de la maintenance et des principes de gestion de la performance.

--------------------------------

Join GE Vernova’s R&D team as the technical bridge between Product Management and Product Development. As a Lead Application Engineer for Asset Performance Solutions, you will take customer needs and product requirements defined by Product Management and translate them into innovative algorithms, solution designs, and working prototypes that development teams can build. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within R&D with no people management responsibilities. It demands deep domain expertise in Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), Asset Performance Management (APM), and Asset Management, combined with a strong mathematical, statistical, and optimization foundation.

The Lead Application Engineer will own the end-to-end solution design process—from receiving prioritized requirements and customer pain points through to delivering algorithm specifications and working prototypes ready for development handoff. The successful candidate will be a strong communicator, with a methodical and structured approach to problem-solving and comprehensive understanding of asset reliability, maintenance optimization, and performance management principles.

Job Description
Responsabilités principales
- Traduire les exigences de gestion de produit, les besoins des clients et les tendances du marché en conceptions techniques détaillées, spécifications algorithmiques et documents d'architecture pour les solutions de performance et de fiabilité des actifs.

- Développer des prototypes de preuve de concept et des modèles mathématiques utilisant Python, Java et des outils statistiques/d'optimisation pour valider les solutions proposées pour les cas d'utilisation RCM, APM et gestion des actifs.

- Concevoir et affiner des algorithmes mathématiques, statistiques et d'optimisation pour la maintenance prédictive, l'analyse des modes de défaillance, l'évaluation de l'état de santé des actifs et l'optimisation des coûts du cycle de vie.

- Collaborer avec la gestion de produit pour comprendre les exigences de fonctionnalités et les besoins des clients, et travailler avec les équipes de développement pour garantir la faisabilité technique et le transfert fluide des spécifications et prototypes.

- Rédiger des livres blancs techniques, des résumés de solutions et présenter des contenus lors de conférences industrielles pour établir un leadership d'opinion dans la gestion de la performance des actifs et l'ingénierie de la fiabilité.

- Influencer l'orientation technique par des recommandations basées sur les données, des analyses concurrentielles et une expertise métier afin d'orienter les décisions de stratégie produit.

- Identifier des opportunités d'innovations brevetables dans l'analyse de la performance des actifs, les algorithmes de maintenance prédictive et les techniques d'optimisation pour renforcer le portefeuille de propriété intellectuelle de GE Vernova.

- Fournir des conseils techniques et du mentorat aux membres des équipes de développement sur les concepts métiers, les approches algorithmiques et l'architecture des solutions.

- Analyser les tendances du marché, les normes industrielles (ISO 55000, CEI, cadres RCM) et les exigences clients pour proposer de nouvelles capacités algorithmiques et des améliorations produits pour les solutions APM de GE Vernova.

• Éducation et expérience requises
- Master ou Doctorat en ingénierie, mathématiques appliquées, statistiques, recherche opérationnelle ou discipline quantitative connexe auprès d'une institution accréditée, ou connaissances/expérience équivalentes.

- Minimum 8 ans d'expérience en R&D, développement d'algorithmes ou ingénierie de solutions. Minimum 3 ans à l'intersection de la gestion de produit et des équipes d'ingénierie/développement, traduisant des besoins métier en spécifications techniques.

- Expérience approfondie en maintenance centrée sur la fiabilité (RCM), gestion de la performance des actifs (APM) et/ou gestion des actifs au sein d'industries à forte intensité d'actifs (services publics, énergie, pétrole et gaz, fabrication).

- Maîtrise de Python et Java, avec une expérience pratique du développement d'algorithmes, de pipelines de données ou d'outils analytiques.

- Solides bases en modélisation mathématique, analyse statistique et techniques d'optimisation (ex: programmation linéaire/non linéaire, méthodes bayésiennes, analyse de survie, simulation de Monte-Carlo).

- Expérience avérée dans la publication, la présentation lors de forums industriels et l'influence sur l'orientation produit.

- Connaissance des normes industrielles pertinentes (ISO 55000/55001, PAS 55, série CEI 60300, SAE JA1011/JA1012 pour le RCM).

- Connaissance des plateformes APM modernes, des tendances en analyse prédictive et des développements en matière de jumeaux numériques / maintenance conditionnelle.

• Caractéristiques souhaitées
- Expérience de travail dans des environnements de développement produit agiles, en collaboration avec des Product Owners et des équipes Scrum.

- Exposition aux techniques de machine learning et de data science appliquées à la maintenance prédictive, à la détection d'anomalies ou à l'analyse de l'état de santé des actifs.

- Capacité démontrée à communiquer des concepts techniques complexes à des publics variés et à établir des relations de travail solides entre la gestion de produit, l'ingénierie et les équipes en contact avec la clientèle.

- Connaissance des modèles d'intégration d'entreprise, des API et des standards d'échange de données pertinents pour les plateformes APM/EAM (ex: OPC-UA, MQTT, REST/GraphQL).

- Une expérience dans les systèmes de transport et de distribution (T&D) est un atout.

La différence crée l’énergie.
La Mission Handicap Grid Solutions facilite l’intégration des personnes en situation de handicap.
--------------------------------------------------------

Core Responsibilities

- Translate product management requirements, customer needs, and market insights into detailed technical solution designs, algorithm specifications, and architecture documents for asset performance and reliability solutions.

- Develop proof-of-concept prototypes and mathematical models using Python, Java, and statistical/optimization tools to validate proposed solutions for RCM, APM, and asset management use cases.

- Design and refine mathematical, statistical, and optimization algorithms for predictive maintenance, failure mode analysis, asset health scoring, and lifecycle cost optimization.

- Work with Product Management to receive and understand prioritized feature requirements and customer needs and collaborate with Development teams to ensure technical feasibility and smooth handoff of solution specifications and prototypes.

- Author technical white papers, solution briefs, and present materials at industry conferences to establish thought leadership in asset performance management and reliability engineering.

- Influence technical direction through data-driven recommendations, competitive analysis, and domain expertise to inform product strategy decisions made by Product Management.

- Identify opportunities for patentable innovations in asset performance analytics, predictive maintenance algorithms, and optimization techniques to strengthen GE Vernova’s Intellectual Property portfolio.

- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to development team members on domain concepts, algorithmic approaches, and solution architecture.

- Analyse market trends, industry standards (ISO 55000, IEC, RCM frameworks), and customer requirements to propose new algorithmic capabilities and product enhancements for GE Vernova’s Asset Performance Management solutions.

Education and experience required
- Master’s or PhD in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or related quantitative discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent knowledge or experience.

- Minimum 8 years of experience in R&D, algorithm development, or solution engineering roles. Minimum of 3 years working at the intersection of product management and engineering/development teams, translating business requirements into technical specifications.

- Extensive domain experience in Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), Asset Performance Management (APM), and/or Asset Management within asset-intensive industries (utilities, energy, oil & gas, manufacturing).

- Strong proficiency in Python and Java, with hands-on experience developing algorithms, data pipelines, or analytical tools.

- Solid foundation in mathematical modeling, statistical analysis, and optimization techniques (e.g., linear/nonlinear programming, Bayesian methods, survival analysis, Monte Carlo simulation).

- Proven track record of publishing, presenting at industry forums, and influencing product direction through technical thought leadership.

- Familiarity with industry standards relevant to asset management and reliability (ISO 55000/55001, PAS 55, IEC 60300 series, SAE JA1011/JA1012 for RCM).

- Knowledge of modern Asset Performance Management platforms, predictive analytics trends, and digital twin / condition-based maintenance developments.

Desired Characteristics
- Experience working in agile product development environments, collaborating with product owners and scrum teams.

- Exposure to machine learning and data science techniques applied to predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, or asset health analytics.

- Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences and build strong working relationships across Product Management, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams.

- Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and data exchange standards relevant to APM/EAM platforms (e.g., OPC-UA, MQTT, REST/GraphQL).

- Experience in transmission and distribution (T&D) systems is preferred.

Job Description Summary
GE Vernova is seeking a Virtualization Product Owner to lead the strategy and roadmap for our virtualized protection and control systems within our Grid Automation team.

Job Description
Do you want to drive the future of digital energy by defining the strategy for virtualized protection and control systems?
GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional   Virtualization Product Owner   to join our   Grid Automation   team based in   Bilbao, Spain .
GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World
With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.
Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life.
Electrification
Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to   power conversion   and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.
Let’s Talk about the Role
The Virtualization Product Owner will define and drive the virtualization strategy and roadmap for our Grid Automation portfolio, bridging the gap between customer needs and technical execution.
You will act as the voice of the product, translating complex market requirements into clear technical plans while guiding the R&D team through the development lifecycle. This role is central to our mission of virtualizing protection and control applications, helping to make energy grids more efficient, adaptable, and future-ready.
How You Will Make a Difference
- Driving   the product vision and strategy for virtualized protection, control, and edge-computing applications.
- Building   and prioritizing the product roadmap by balancing customer value, business objectives, and technical innovation.
- Creating   clear, actionable requirements that translate complex market and stakeholder needs for the engineering teams.
- Leading   backlog management and decision-making on release timing to ensure efficient and high-quality product delivery.
- Collaborating   across engineering, UX/UI, and marketing teams to ensure a seamless path from development to market launch.
- Improving   product performance through continuous feedback loops, data analysis, and iterative enhancements.

Special Role Requirements
- Willingness and ability to travel internationally on a quarterly basis to support global team alignment.

Skills for Success
You should be a visionary product professional with a strong technical background and a passion for industrial automation, with:
- The ability to translate complex technical concepts and market trends into a cohesive product roadmap.
- The capability to engage effectively with both highly technical engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.
- An understanding of Agile methodologies and how to drive product development in a fast-paced environment.
- An expertise in virtualization technologies, such as hypervisors and virtualized application architectures, ideally within power or industrial systems.
- A keen interest in the future of digital substations and grid modernization.

A formal education in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field is nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements in product management or systems engineering.
Where and how you'll work
This is a permanent position based in our Bilbao office or alternatively in Stafford, UK or Dubai. We have a hybrid working model which gives you the flexibility to work from our offices and from home.
Our Culture
Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.
Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.
Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!
We're determined to be the best place to grow
We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.
We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.
Inclusion & Diversity
We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.
As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.
Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.
